Scientists identify two ages when children may be most vulnerable to screen time
stories.t: Scientists have identified two potentially critical periods when screen time may be especially detrimental to children's learning and memory: infancy and the start of formal schooling.

stories.h: Netflix’s coziest show has made a very quiet return
stories.t: The bigger Netflix gets, the easier it is to miss stuff. This is true of all digital platforms, of course, but it's especially true of Netflix of late, as the streaming service's lineup now also includes a growing library of reality shows, live-programming, and even games.

stories.h: Astronomers may have discovered a black hole born before the first stars
stories.t: A mysterious object named Phoebe, detected when it briefly magnified a distant star, could be a primordial black hole formed just after the Big Bang.
